Thank you!

Thank you for taking the time to provide us with your information. Regrettably, we are unable to proceed with your application at this time.

We want to assure you that we have only conducted a soft search, so it will not appear on your credit file or impact any future applications you may make.

If you would like more information regarding this decision, please feel free to email us at hello@loansbymal.co.uk.

However, if you believe there may have been errors in the information you provided, you are welcome to reapply.

Thank you
